request_payload.input: I want to compare two English-to-German systems on held-out online news from late 2019. Which public test set and scoring setup should I use?
request_payload.instructions: Answer the research question from existing knowledge. Aim for 180–240 words and do not exceed 300 words. Do not browse or use external tools. Do not ask a follow-up question.

output_text:
For comparing English-to-German systems on held-out online news from late 2019, use the **WMT20 news translation test set (`newstest2020`)**. This public test set was created for the WMT20 shared task and consists of news articles sourced from late 2019 (and early 2020), making it temporally appropriate and fully held out from typical training data.

For scoring, use **SacreBLEU** with the official WMT20 evaluation setup:

- **Metric:** BLEU, case-sensitive (`case:mixed`)
- **Tokenization:** `tok:13a` (the standard Moses tokenizer for English/German)
- **Smoothing:** `exp` (the default in SacreBLEU)
- **References:** Use all available references (typically 3 for en–de in WMT20)

An example command:

```bash
sacrebleu -t wmt20 -l en-de -m bleu
```

This automatically applies the correct signature:  
`BLEU|nrefs:3|case:mixed|eff:no|tok:13a|smooth:exp`

If you have your system outputs, pass the reference file and use the same parameters. This setup is reproducible and directly comparable with published WMT20 results.
